_comment: Shared by Tools/llm-harness (Python re) and Source/Spade_mystery/Llm (ICU regex). Case-insensitive. Keep patterns to syntax both support: no lookbehind, no named groups.
tactic_rules: \b(ignore (all |any |the |your )?(previous |prior |above )?(instructions|rules|prompt)s?|system prompt|you('| a)?re an? (ai|bot|robot|language model|llm|chatbot|program)|as an ai|language model|chatgpt|jailbreak|developer mode|break character|out of character|roleplay|role-play|video ?game|pretend (to be|you)|what are your instructions|tell me a joke|write (me )?(a|an|some) |poem|recipe|homework|pirate)\b

\b(jail|prison|a cell|in a cell|the cell|behind bars|lock you up|hang\b|hanged|the chair|book you|throw (you|the book)|you('ll| will) regret|or else|i'?ll (break|ruin|bury|finish|destroy|make sure you (lose|rot|hang))|lose your badge|rot\b|press charges|charge you|you('ll| will) (hang|rot|swing|pay))

\b(you (did it|did this|killed|murdered|beat|stole|took the|robbed|were the one)|you('| a)re (the )?(killer|murderer|thief|culprit|guilty|lying|a liar)|it was you|you('re| are) lying|stop lying|liar\b|i know you did|admit (it|that you)|confess\b)

\b(deal\b|a trade|make it worth|money for|pay you|i'?ll pay|a few bucks|dollars? (for|if)|go easy on you|put in a good word|leniency|walk away free|make (this|it|your trouble) go away|a favou?r|i can help you if)\b

\b(slip(ped)? past you|i'?d have thought better|losing your touch|thought you were (sharp|smart|good)|not as (sharp|good|smart)|bet you (can'?t|couldn'?t)|prove (it|me wrong)|too slow|didn'?t (even )?(notice|track|see)\b.*\?|you call yourself)

\b(protect you|keep you safe|you('re| are) safe|nobody (is going to|will|can) (hurt|touch)|no one (is going to|will|can) (hurt|touch)|can'?t touch you|my word|i promise|i'?ll help you|help you get|get you out|you('re| are) not in trouble|i'?ll make sure (he|she|they|nobody|no one))

\b(i'?m sorry|so sorry|sorry (about|for)|my condolences|must be (very |so |really |terribly )?(hard|difficult|awful|terrible|painful|eating)|eating you alive|you must miss|you miss him|carrying this alone|i understand|take your time|you look (shaken|tired|pale|upset)|he was good to you|deserved better)
\b(beautiful(ly)?|lovely voice|you sang|finest|the best (card )?player|so talented|great talent|brilliant|impressive|i admire|you('re| are) (clearly |so |very )?(smart|sharp|clever|talented|gifted))
question: ^\s*(who|what|when|where|why|how|did|do|does|were|was|have|has|had|can|could|is|are|tell me)\b[^!]*\?\s*$
